B: Hello! Hi, I'm Callum. Can you hear me alright?
A: Yes, fine. Gillian.
B: Gillian, nice to meet you. Ooh, is that a kitchen island? Very fancy.
A: Thank you. It's new-ish. Two years. Erm, sorry, do you know what this study's actually for? Nobody's said.
B: Honestly, no idea. I think they just want to see if we all get on. I've had three so far and I've got on with everyone, so I'm smashing it.
A: Right. Well done.
B: Ha. So where are you, Gillian?
A: Bramhall. Near Stockport. It's a nice area. I'm an optometrist, I do three days in Stockport town centre.
B: Oh, an optician! My mum's always on at me to get my eyes tested, I squint at the telly.
A: You should. If you're squinting, get it checked. It's probably just a prescription but you don't know, do you, and people leave things far too long. I had a man last month who'd had a curtain over one eye for a week and he'd just carried on driving. A week. Ended up in hospital that afternoon. Erm, yeah. Get it checked.
B: Okay, okay, I'm booking it, I promise. That's grim, a whole week.
A: People don't think about their eyes until they've gone.
B: Yeah, fair. I'm in car sales, so I'm the opposite, I just look at bodywork all day. Used and nearly-new, outside Stevenage.
A: Oh, you and the girl from Basingstoke, then. Gemma.
B: Yeah, Gemma! She's top of her board, she made sure I knew.
A: She did seem quite... sure of herself.
B: Ha, that's diplomatic. Erm, is that a wine bottle behind you? Have you got one open?
A: Not yet. That's for later. Married at First Sight's on.
B: Oh, my mum loves that. She watches it with my dad, he pretends he's not watching it.
A: Martin's the same. Do you live near your mum, then?
B: Erm, I'm actually back at my mum and dad's at the minute. Saving for a deposit. Sort of.
A: Oh. Well, a lot of them are, aren't they. My daughter'll be back after uni, I expect, she's already ringing for money every week.
B: Ha, yeah. I pay board, to be fair. Most months.
A: Most months.
B: Most months! Don't tell my mum. Erm, so what's Martin into, then? Football?
A: City. He has it on all the time, I sort of half listen.
B: Oh no, City. I'm Arsenal. Tell Martin I'm sorry for him, actually, no, tell him I'm jealous.
A: I'll pass it on. He'll be insufferable.
B: Ha. Do you watch films at all? I'm a bit of a film nerd. I watched this Korean thriller last night, it was unreal.
A: I don't really do arty films. I find them boring, if I'm honest. I like a crime drama on ITV, something where you know who did it by the end.
B: No, that's fair, that's fair. This one you do know who did it. Sort of. Eventually.
A: Mm.
B: Okay, I'll stop selling it to you. Old habits.
